section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the growing research on the physical health benefits of gratitude, defining it as a dispositional orientation towards appreciating positive life aspects. It highlights gratitude's operationalization, its well-documented social and psychological benefits, and emerging evidence for its protective role in self-reported physical health. The current study aims to address a gap in the literature by examining the psychosocial mechanisms underlying the gratitude-health link.
